Name: (CP) July's Asparagus
Author: julycanthrope
Description:
This mod adds Asparagus as a crop, and Roasted Asparagus as a cooked dish, using Content Patcher.

Asparagus can be planted in the spring and takes 12 days to grow, and is harvested with the scythe. Seeds are 80g at Pierre's, and the Asparagus sells for 180g. Asparagus only restores 25 Energy when eaten raw because I imagine it would take some energy to chew in the first place.

The recipe for Roasted Asparagus can be purchased from the Saloon for 500g, and takes 2 Asparagus and 1 Oil to cook. It sells for 550g or restores 250 Energy when eaten.


Since this was mostly just for practice and getting my foot in the door, I probably won't make any changes unless there are bugs/issues, but if I do come back to it, here are some future possibilities:

- Potentially add Asparagus and Roasted Asparagus to villagers' gift tastes?
- Revamp the pixel art if I figure out how to develop a more Stardew-like style?
- Add a "stinky pee" debuff if you eat too many? (Probably not, but the idea is funny.)


Thanks for checking out my first ever mod for Stardew Valley! Constructive feedback is highly appreciated (especially if something is
amiss, considering my inexperience).
